name: Concurrency Test Determinism Migration
hypothesis: Replacing timing-threshold concurrency assertions with sync-primitive assertions will reduce flaky build failures without reducing coverage.
change: Migrate known timing-based tests in runner/orchestrator to deterministic overlap proofs (barriers/waitgroups/channels).
measurement: Track test flake rate and build-failure share attributed to test timing over 30 CI runs.
risk: Test refactors may temporarily hide intent if synchronization harnesses are poorly named.

previous_experiment.name: Attribution Quarantine Hard Gate
previous_experiment.final_summary: Inconclusive after 58 iterations across 11 runs. Provider field is structurally MISSING from all run log entries, so the quarantine gate cannot distinguish known vs unknown attribution. Cost dropped 35% but confounded by 33% zero-execution failures. Failure rate rose from 10% to 46.6%.
